description: An elongated, NE–SW trending linear ridge visible in the DTM hillshade. It extends approximately 180 m across the tile and shows uniform width (~3–4 m) and raised shoulders, indicative of a canal or causeway cut into the upland surface for water management.

A cluster of small, circular to sub-rectangular low-relief platforms (approx. 12–20 m diameter) arrayed along and immediately adjacent to the linear ridge. These house-mound platforms appear in near-parallel alignment and may represent associated domestic or storage structures flanking the canal.
